sources.answer: Default failed-episode filtering and latent-range warning are important adaptation boundaries; latent p99 alone is not proof of successful physical action round trip.

joint_derivations.question: Can finite-sample miss establish base has zero action support?
joint_derivations.answer: No. Separate finite candidate coverage, representational edit bounds, Q ranking and BC transfer. Use action-dimension/gripper reachability plus independent labels.
joint_derivations.selection_change: supports conditional RT-EXPO vs native/full-head gate

joint_derivations.question: Does retaining exact predecessors and dropping broken slots remove intervention selection bias?
joint_derivations.answer: No. If dropout depends on hidden risky branch, retained return differs from deployment return. Formal A/B example in report.
joint_derivations.selection_change: retain correct queue semantics; add reason/goal/state censoring diagnostics and bounded autonomous retries

joint_derivations.question: Does realized-terminal actor masking reweight states?
joint_derivations.answer: Yes when Q already averages random current-C termination; survival filtering introduces a second p_survive factor. Root agreed to use all eligible pre-decision nonterminal X for primary actor sampling.
joint_derivations.selection_change: main actor sampling recommendation changed; old future-survival mask only ablation

joint_derivations.question: Does same-MDP expert transition necessarily contaminate task Q?
joint_derivations.answer: No; legal off-policy target under deployment policy can use it. Assistance MC credit, value extrapolation and surrogate objectives must be separated.
joint_derivations.selection_change: do not copy universal takeover terminal or blanket human critic exclusion

joint_derivations.question: Does four-way old/new Harness/policy evaluation establish training causality?
joint_derivations.answer: No. It diagnoses deployment contribution. Add matched training runs from same initial policy, fixed vs expanding program library.

joint_derivations.question: Does FlowDAgger remove need for correction-support checks?
joint_derivations.answer: No. Inversion quality, latent bounds, decoded action/gripper semantics, hidden teacher information and post-hoc chunk timing remain gates.
joint_derivations.selection_change: optional latent-BC precheck added; no RL/core replacement
